name: ai-guidelines
description: Portable AI governance framework — agnostic by design

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:rules
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ts
scripts.consumer:journey: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js consumer-journey all
scripts.consumer:journey:pack: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js consumer-journey pack
scripts.consumer:journey:yalc: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js consumer-journey yalc
scripts.consumer:journey:verdaccio: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js consumer-journey verdaccio
scripts.living-docs:generate: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js living-docs generate
scripts.living-docs:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js living-docs check
scripts.site:flow:sync: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-flow-copy sync
scripts.site:flow:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-flow-copy check
scripts.site:scenarios:sync: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-scenarios sync
scripts.site:scenarios:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-scenarios check
scripts.site:prompts:sync: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-prompts sync
scripts.site:prompts:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js site-prompts check
scripts.site:build: npm run site:flow:check && npm run site:scenarios:check && npm run site:prompts:check && npm run site:assets:check && npm run site:real-package && vite build --config site/vite.config.ts
scripts.state-yml:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js state-yml-check
scripts.state-yml:check:all: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js state-yml-check --all
scripts.active-specs:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js active-specs-check
scripts.reconcile:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js reconcile-check
scripts.research-index:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js research-index-check
scripts.artifact-kind:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js artifact-kind-check
scripts.handoff:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js handoff-check
scripts.drift:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js drift --check
scripts.co-knowledge:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js co-knowledge-check
scripts.co-knowledge:inventory: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js co-knowledge-inventory
scripts.constraints:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js constraints-check
scripts.knowledge:compile: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js knowledge-compile compile
scripts.knowledge:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js knowledge-compile check
scripts.script-contracts:sync: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js script-contracts sync
scripts.script-contracts:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js script-contracts check
scripts.runtime-bootstrap:sync: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js runtime-bootstrap sync
scripts.runtime-bootstrap:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js runtime-bootstrap check
scripts.gate-decidability:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js gate-decidability-check
scripts.ruleset:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js ruleset-check
scripts.review:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js review-check
scripts.insights:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js insights-check
scripts.intent:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js intent-check
scripts.disclosure: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js disclosure-render
scripts.review:publish: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js review-publish
scripts.review:seal: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js review-seal
scripts.pr-body:update: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-body-update
scripts.pr-body:create: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-body-create
scripts.pr-body:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-body-check
scripts.pr-body:publish: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-body-publish
scripts.pr-body:pull: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-body-pull
scripts.pr-ready:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/bin.js pr-ready-check
scripts.validate:changed: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js validate changed
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run build:all && npm run script-contracts:check && npm run runtime-bootstrap:check && npm run test && npm run living-docs:check && npm run site:build && npm run state-yml:check && npm run active-specs:check && npm run reconcile:check && npm run research-index:check && npm run artifact-kind:check && npm run drift:check && npm run co-knowledge:check && npm run co-knowledge:inventory && npm run constraints:check && npm run knowledge:check && npm run gate-decidability:check && npm run ruleset:check && npm run review:check && npm run insights:check && npm run intent:check
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run validate && npm run state-yml:check:all
